verdict.rationale: The SDK offers structured outputs with 'validated JSON matching your schema' and custom tools with defined function schemas, which support schema validation, but this validation happens at runtime ('at the end'), not as compile/build-time type checking, and there's no documentation of static type-checking or build-time error catching for agent-authored code. missing for 10: evidence of build-time/static type validation (e.g., TypeScript type generation, compile-time schema enforcement), explicit claims about catching mistakes before execution, and independent corroboration of typing rigor.
